# C++ dependencies

Vendored single headers, downloaded from their official repositories:

- nlohmann/json v3.11.3: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.11.3 (MIT).
- cpp-httplib v0.18.6: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib/tree/v0.18.6 (MIT).

License notices are retained in the headers. Builds are offline after source transfer.
